ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What stage of the mosquito life cycle is shown at letter C?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a mosquito life cycle with arrows moving around four labeled stages. Letter A is beside an adult mosquito on the left. Letter B is beside a worm-like aquatic form on the right. Letter C is at the bottom beside a small curled, comma-shaped aquatic form. Letter D is at the top beside a raft-like group of eggs. Reasoning: In the mosquito life cycle, the sequence is eggs, larva, pupa, adult. Since C is the curled stage after the larva-like stage B and before the adult stage A, letter C represents the pupa stage.
